name: Open the console from the front page, sign in, land in the console
description: A signed-out reader clicks the ink button Open the console, is sent to sign in, signs in with email and password, and arrives in the Eagle S replay console.

planSteps.description: Click the button Open the console (data-testid open-console)
Assert the URL path is /sign-in and the form (data-testid account-form) shows an Email field, a Password field and a Sign in button
In the sign-in form (data-testid account-form), type testsprite@example.com in the Email field and cabletrace-testsprite-2026 in the Password field, then click Sign in
Assert that within 30 seconds the URL path is /cases/eagle-s-2024 and the replay console (data-testid replay-console) is shown
